# Frontend Design

Use this skill when the request is primarily about UI design direction, visual polish, or UX presentation quality.

## Selective Reading Rule

Read only the sections that match the task.

## Content Map

| File | Use When |
| --- | --- |
| `decision-trees.md` | Choosing style direction and tradeoffs |
| `color-system.md` | Selecting palettes and semantic color usage |
| `typography-system.md` | Font pairing and readable hierarchy |
| `animation-guide.md` | Defining animation principles and timing |
| `motion-graphics.md` | Advanced motion and transitions |
| `visual-effects.md` | Shadows, glass, gradients, depth |
| `ux-psychology.md` | Behavior-driven UX decisions |

## Recommended Workflow

1. Define product context and target users.
2. Pick a visual direction with `decision-trees.md`.
3. Build tokens using `color-system.md` and `typography-system.md`.
4. Add purposeful motion using `animation-guide.md`.
5. Validate accessibility and responsiveness before finalizing.

## Notes for IntellEvalPro

- Keep role-based visual identity consistent.
- Prioritize 390px mobile baseline first, then scale up.
- Use clear interaction feedback and accessible contrast.
